count_validation.basis: Individual block payloads vary in sector/record contribution while complete wave segments preserve their balanced cluster totals.

ablation.gate_semantics: Both arms must meet per-cell count/rate accuracy; pooled wave-segment count/rate p95 must be non-inferior; every predeclared sensitive witness must preserve rate non-inferiority and at least one must have a strict rate advantage. Neutral per-cell ordering is diagnostic.

per_cell.co_residency_thinning_proxy: The flat L2 replay detects selection-unit/cache-order bias; it does not claim a causal concurrency mechanism.
per_cell.ordinary_draw: SRSWOR individual .pb payloads; fixed RNG seed offset
per_cell.count_adjustment: wave arm uses the production calibrated HT estimator; independent sector count uses certainty + ordinary-block HT then exact-record calibration
per_cell.rate_adjustment: certainty-adjusted inverse-probability hit/sector difference ratio; the hit contrast is not claimed additive under cache interference
